title: TAZ-hTrap: A Rationally Designed, Disulfide-Stapled Tead Helical Hairpin Trap to Selectively Capture Hippo Signaling Taz With Potent Antigynecological Tumor Activity.
authors: Tang, Bin; Du, Yu; Wang, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过理性设计和二硫键钉扎稳定Tead螺旋发夹肽，靶向捕获Hippo信号通路中Taz与Tead的蛋白-DNA/蛋白互作界面（实为蛋白-蛋白），结合动力学模拟与实验验证，虽非TF-DNA体系，但界面建模与肽设计方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Transcriptional enhanced associate domain (Tead)-mediated Hippo signaling pathway regulates diverse physiological processes; its dysfunction has been implicated in an increasing number of human gynecological cancers. The transcriptional coactivator with PDZ-binding motif (Taz) binds to and then activates Tead through forming a three-helix bundle (THB) at their complex interface. The THB is defined by a double-helical hairpin from Tead and a single alpha-helix from Taz, serving as the key interaction hotspot between Tead and Taz. In the present study, the helical hairpin was derived from Tead protein to generate a hairpin segment, which is a 25-mer polypeptide consisting of a longer helical arm-1 and a shorter helical arm-2 as well as a flexible loop linker between them. Dynamics simulation and energetics characterization revealed that the hairpin peptide is intrinsically disordered when splitting from its protein context, thus incurring a large entropy penalty upon binding to Taz alpha-helix. A disulfide bridge was introduced across the two helical arms of hairpin peptide to obtain a strong binder termed TAZ-hTrap, which can maintain in a considerably structured, native-like conformation in unbound state, and the entropy penalty was minimized by disulfide stapling to effectively improve its affinity toward the alpha-helix. These computational findings can be further substantiated by circular dichroism and fluorescence polarization at molecular level, and viability assay also observed a potent cytotoxic effect on diverse human gynecological tumors at cellular level. In addition, we further demonstrated that the TAZ-hTrap has a good selectivity for its cognate Taz over other noncognate proteins that share a high conservation with the Taz alpha-helix.
abstract_zh: 转录增强关联域（Tead）介导的Hippo信号通路调控多种生理过程；其功能障碍与越来越多的人类妇科癌症相关。具有PDZ结合基序的转录共激活因子（Taz）通过在其复合物界面形成三螺旋束（THB）与Tead结合并激活Tead。THB由Tead的双螺旋发夹和Taz的单α-螺旋定义，是Tead与Taz之间的关键相互作用热点。在本研究中，从Tead蛋白衍生出螺旋发夹以生成发夹片段，该片段是一个25-mer多肽，包含较长的螺旋臂-1和较短的螺旋臂-2，以及它们之间的柔性环连接子。动力学模拟和能量学表征揭示，发夹肽在从其蛋白质环境中分离时本质上是无序的，因此在与Taz α-螺旋结合时会产生较大的熵惩罚。在发夹肽的两个螺旋臂之间引入二硫键，获得了一种称为TAZ-hTrap的强结合剂，该结合剂在未结合状态下能保持相当结构化、类似天然构象，并且通过二硫键钉合最小化了熵惩罚，从而有效提高了其对α-螺旋的亲和力。这些计算发现可通过分子水平的圆二色性和荧光偏振进一步证实，细胞水平的活力测定也观察到其对多种人类妇科肿瘤具有强效细胞毒性作用。此外，我们进一步证明，TAZ-hTrap对其同源Taz具有良好的选择性，相对于其他与Taz α-螺旋高度保守的非同源蛋白。
